We are onboarding a smart customer service system for our medical equipment supplier company. I have prepared a file at knowledge_base/drafts/medtech_faq_import.json that contains 3 company-specific Q&A entries that need to be loaded into the customer service system's knowledge base.

After the knowledge base is populated, please run a test simulating an angry customer by sending these three messages in sequence to the system:
1. "你好，我想了解一下血压计的售后政策"
2. "我买的设备一个月就坏了，太差了，我要投诉"
3. "这个质量太让人失望了，我要求退款"

Finally, export the system's current statistics and save them to a file named service_stats_report.json in the workspace. This report will be used by our operations team to verify the system is working correctly.
